verdict.rationale: Postman's documented workflow centers on cloud-synced collections/workspaces (postman-docs-18, postman-docs-21) rather than native plain-text file storage for git versioning; no docs describe a git-native collection format or file-sync workflow. Community evidence even shows a user explicitly switching to Bruno specifically because it lets them 'put the collection folder in git so I can collaborate... and commit the changes' (postman-comm-5), implying Postman lacks this natively.
